original: いつも妙ちくりんなことばっかり書いてるもんだから、きっとコメントしにくいんだわ！

en.text: I'm always writing weird and hoopy stuff so I'm sure it's difficult to comment on.
I'm always writing strange things, so I'm sure it's difficult to comment on.
